scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Good day, young one. I have the power to remove cards that you have compounded onto your equipment. Does this idea please you?
Yes, it does.
What do you charge?
No thanks.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Very well. Which item shall I examine for you?

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Young one... Your not wearing anything there that I can remove cards from.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Young one... There are no cards compounded on this item. I can do nothing with it, I'm afraid.

^3355FFJust a minute!
I can't offer any of my
services to you because
you're carrying too much
stuff. Put your extra items in
Kafra Storage and come again~

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: This item has {0} cards compounded on it. To perform my magic, I will need {1} zeny, a ^0000FFStar Crumb^000000, and a ^0000FFYellow Gemstone^000000.
Very well. Do it.
Never mind.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Very well. Return at once if you seek my services.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: You do not have all the items I require to work my magic, child. Come again when you do.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Before I begin, I must warn you--I may fail. If I do, I may destroy the cards, the item, or both. I do not give refunds. That being said, which is more important to you: The cards, or the item?
I changed my mind about this.
The item.
The cards.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Very well. Return at once if you seek my services.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Very well. I shall begin.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: The process was a total failure. I am afraid the item and the cards were destroyed.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: While I have managed to remove the cards from the item, they were destroyed in the process. The item, however, is okay.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Most unfortunate. I succeeded at removing the cards, but the item itself was destroyed in the process.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: I have failed to remove the cards. Luckily, however, both the item and the cards are still okay.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: The process was a success. Here are your cards and your item. Farewell.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: I charge a flat fee of {0} zeny, plus {1} zeny for each card I remove from the item. In addition, I need a star crumb and a yellow gemstone to work my magic.

scripts.speaker: Wise Old Woman
scripts.text: Very well. Return at once if you seek my services.
